title: Estimates and approvals
purpose: Public promise on estimates: written, per job, nothing without approval.
facts: Estimate after inspection or diagnosis; written; each job priced separately with parts, labour, tax and evidence.
Approval is per job (ERP order_job approved or declined), by text or e-mail reply, phone or in person; who and when is recorded.
The approved amount is never exceeded without a new approval.
Declined work is recorded as deferred and raises a reminder (ERP service_reminder).
Inspection and diagnosis fees are charged regardless.

list_items.item: We look first. A price for a repair comes after an inspection or a diagnosis, not before.
You get it in writing. The estimate lists each job separately with its parts, labour and tax, and the photos or measurements behind it.

You approve job by job. Say yes to the brakes and no to the shocks if you like. You can approve by replying to the text or e-mail we send, on the phone, or at the counter. We write down who approved and when.
We do not go over. If a job turns out to need more than you approved, we stop and ask. No approval, no extra work.
Work you put off is not forgotten. We note it on your car's record and remind you. No pressure.

new_facts: Estimate validity 30 days. Reason: needed by the deposit and price-change pages; common shop practice.
Policy "in force from T-26mo": before the ERP history starts, so no order in the data predates it.

notes_for_russian_writer: Russian trade: the order (заказ-наряд) is signed by the customer; extra work is agreed by phone and added to the order. Estimate validity: write the Russian habit (often 7 to 14 days because parts prices move); propose 14 days as a new fact.
